calls.reasoning: Q3 FY27 guide: rev $108B±2%, GM 74%, GAAP opex $9.2B, tax 16-18%. NVDA beat revenue guidance by ~5% in Q1/Q2, so I assume ~$112-113B and ~$2.58-2.60/sh before equity gains (consensus non-GAAP $2.47-2.53; NVDA beat in 7 of 8 qtrs). GAAP EPS also includes mark-to-market gains on equity stakes ($15.9B in Q1, $7.8B in Q2). For Jul 24 to Oct 23 closes: SpaceX ~$105-112 to ~$145 on 122.8M sh (about +$4B); Intel $92.32 to $86.87 on 214.8M sh (-$1.2B); CoreWeave ~$62-65 to $54.81 (-$0.5B); Nebius/others mostly down. OpenAI's round is not closed before the Oct 25 quarter end and Anthropic's IPO is mid-Nov, so no big private mark is assumed. Net gains ~+$2B (+$0.07/sh) give a median of ~$2.66. Market check: no GAAP EPS market found; Polymarket non-GAAP beat markets and a Manifold Q3 revenue market are near-miss contracts, not anchors.
